rules.accepted_credit_types: CE in veterinary medicine regardless of delivery method (online and asynchronous accepted); CE used for another state's renewal may count
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal after initial registration.
rules.alternatives: Requirement met by active enrollment in an AVMA CVTEA-accredited program during the biennium; hardship waiver under IC 25-1-4-4.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation 3 years after the renewal period.
rules.notes: Registered veterinary technicians renew January 1 of even years (next Jan 1, 2028).
